definitions.gloss: to sightsee; to go see (a sight or attraction)
definitions.explanation: To visit and look at places of interest, tourist attractions, or notable sights.

definitions.gloss: to watch; to be a spectator
definitions.explanation: To watch an event, performance, or scene as an onlooker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見物|けんぶつ}した。
examples.english: I went sightseeing at the temples in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見物|けんぶつ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go see the famous cherry blossom spots.

examples.english: I went early to claim a spot to watch the fireworks festival.

notes:
Composed of {見|けん} (see, look) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing). Used both as a suru verb ({見物|けんぶつ}する) and as a noun (⟦{見物|けんぶつ}→見物：01398_kenbutsu⟧). Has a slightly old-fashioned or traditional tone compared to ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ for tourism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{見物|けんぶつ}→見物：01398_kenbutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go sightseeing
- {見物|けんぶつ}して⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to go around seeing the sights
- ⟦{見物人|けんぶつにん}→見物人：27722_kenbutsunin⟧: spectator, onlooker
- {見物客|けんぶつきゃく}: sightseer, tourist
- ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦{見物|けんぶつ}→見物：01398_kenbutsu⟧: cherry blossom viewing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do tourism, to sightsee — more modern and commonly used for tourism
- ⟦{観覧|かんらん}→観覧：08382_kanran⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to view, to watch — more formal, used for organized viewings
- ⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tour, to observe — educational or inspective purpose
